overview: Dr. Ianov has considerable formal training in genetics, neuroscience, omics sequencing approaches, and bioinformatics analyses and development. Dr. Ianov is the Managing Director of the UAB Biological Data Science Core (U-BDS - https://www.uab.edu/cores/ircp/bds) and bioinformatics specialist of the Neurodevelopmental Bioinformatics Initiative from the CIRC. Dr. Ianov provides assistance to researchers in the biomedical community from UAB in the design, execution, and analysis of high-throughput sequencing studies with a focus on transcriptomics, epigenomics, single-cell/nuclei approaches. She and her team also provides support for the development of secondary pipelines and custom web applications.
